{{Quote|General, the Seppies are moving in. They've targeted&hellip; an unallied vessel. It's making planetfall on Florrum.|CC-5052 reports Shahan Alama's craft to Aayla Secura|<ref name="Hunting the Hunters Part I" />}}
A '''battle''' took place on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]] in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. After aiding in the [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|liberation]] of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]] from [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] custody, the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Shahan Alama/Legends|Shahan Alama]] attempted to go into hiding from the Republic. However, Alama encountered a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Unidentified Munificent-class star frigate (Florrum)|frigate]] over Florrum while on the run, and the [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|frigate's]] [[Unidentified Neimoidian captain|Neimoidian captain]] deployed [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]] to engage [[Shahan Alama's Flarestar-class attack shuttle|Alama's craft]]. A Republic [[Aayla Secura's Acclamator-class assault ship|transport]] under the command of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] was patrolling the area, and Secura dispatched [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Bly/Legends|CC-5052]] with a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|troopers]] and a [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunship]] to assess the situation. The [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] eliminated the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Starfighter/Legends|fighters]] on the surface of Florrum and shot down Alama's [[Flarestar-class attack shuttle/Legends|craft]] before returning to Secura's [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|vessel]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Your next task is the final stage of this gambit. ''Disappearing.'' The Republic will be watching. You are to scatter to any corner that will hide you. Where you go, I don't care, but don't get caught. I trust you were smart enough to secure temporary conveyance. Bury your prides. It would not do to travel in a signature vessel while on the run like this.|Cad Bane orders the members of his team to flee|<ref name="Hunting the Hunters Part I" />}}
[[File:Posse_debriefing.png|thumb|left|250px|Bane's team debriefs following their successful rescue of Ziro.]]
In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]<ref name="Date" /> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] formed a team of hunters to free [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]]&mdash;who had been [[Raid on Ziro the Hutt's Coruscant club|arrested]] for crimes against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]&mdash;from the [[Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center/Legends|Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center]] on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The hunters' [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|mission]] was successful, and Bane and his team escaped with Ziro.<ref name="Hostage Crisis" /> Shortly thereafter, Bane transmitted the [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|monetary reward]] for the mission into the accounts of his comrades and then ordered his accomplices to flee and hide from the Republic. One member of the team, the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Shahan Alama/Legends|Shahan Alama]], was mistrustful of Bane, doubting that Bane had sent them their full payment. However, Alama cooperated and escaped in his [[Shahan Alama's Flarestar-class attack shuttle|''Flarestar''-class attack shuttle]] to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Hunting the Hunters Part I" />

==The battle==
{{Quote|Sir, we've spotted a Republic gunship in the vicinity!''"<br />"''Fortune shines twice upon us! Divert squads to engage!|The OOM battle droid lieutenant reports the arrival of the Republic gunship to the Neimoidian captain|<ref name="Hunting the Hunters Part I" />}}
[[File:Battle_of_Florrum.png|thumb|left|250px|The Confederate frigate engages Alama's ship.]]
Over the Outer Rim [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]], Alama came across a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Unidentified Munificent-class star frigate (Florrum)|''Munificent''-class star frigate]]. The [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|frigate's]] [[Unidentified Neimoidian captain|Neimoidian captain]] recognized Alama's [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] as the [[Flarestar-class attack shuttle/Legends|same model]] of starship that was used by a [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|gang of pirates]], which was led by the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] and was based on Florrum. Upon accessing the [[Sector/Legends|sector's]] threat files, the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] confirmed that the Confederate [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] had once been [[Mission to Florrum/Legends|captured]] by the pirates. Deducing that Alama was a member of the pirate gang and seeking payback for the pirates' crimes against the Confederacy, the captain ordered an [[Unidentified OOM command battle droid lieutenant|OOM command battle droid lieutenant]] to target the attack [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]]. As his craft was attacked by the [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]], Alama headed to the surface of Florrum.<ref name="Hunting the Hunters Part I" />

Meanwhile, a Republic task force,<ref name="Hunting the Hunters Part I" /> consisting of a [[Aayla Secura's Acclamator-class assault ship|single]] [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]]<ref name="Gunship Over Florrum" /> under the command of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]], was scouting the area. [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Marshal Commander]] [[Bly/Legends|CC-5052]] reported Alama's independent vessel to Secura, who ordered the [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone commander]] to take a single [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunship]] and gather more information through a reconnaissance of the planet. CC-5052 assembled a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] for his [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] and was accompanied by several other gunships<ref name="Hunting the Hunters Part I" /> to the surface of Florrum.<ref name="Gunship Over Florrum" />

Upon detecting the Republic gunship, the Confederate captain ordered his [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighter]] forces to attack the enemy craft. [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid starfighters]], [[Hyena-class bomber/Legends|''Hyena''-class bombers]], and [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] on [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform/Legends|Single Trooper Aerial Platforms]] were dispatched to confront the Republic gunship. The gunship engaged the enemy forces, and CC-5052 and his crew were able to defeat the Confederate [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. After then engaging and shooting down Alama's craft, the Republic gunship returned to Secura's ''Acclamator''-class [[Transport/Legends|transport]].<ref name="Gunship Over Florrum" />

==Aftermath==
[[File:Alama_crashed.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Alama abandons his crash site on Florrum.]]
{{Quote|You bring unwanted attention to our little world here, ''bounty hunter''.''"<br />"''<nowiki></nowiki>''Hondo!'' Extend a neighborly hand to a Weequay in need, would you?''"<br />"''Oh, but of course! We will offer our hospitality. And determine who wants you so badly, and for how much!|Hondo Ohnaka greets Shahan Alama|<ref name="Hunting the Hunters Part I" />}}
A wounded Alama left his damaged craft and came across Hondo Ohnaka, with whom the bounty hunter was acquainted. However, Ohnaka expressed his intent to take Alama hostage and sell him to whomever wanted to capture him.<ref name="Hunting the Hunters Part I" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle first appeared in [[The Clone Wars: Hunting the Hunters (Part I)|''Hunting the Hunters (Part I)'']], an [[Star Wars comic books|issue]] of the online [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (webcomics)|''The Clone Wars'' webcomic series]] that transitioned between the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first]] and [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second seasons]] of the [[2008]] ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series.<ref name="Hunting the Hunters Part I" />

Even though ''Hunting the Hunters (Part I)'' states that only one gunship was sent, four were pictured.<ref name="Hunting the Hunters Part I" /> During ''[[Gunship Over Florrum]]'', an online game released on [[StarWars.com]] that was based on the events of the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]], only one gunship participated in the battle.<ref name="Gunship Over Florrum" />
